source_evidence: Player exact 'First and foremost, lets sell what we need to sell. Then buy supplies and magical equipment and other equipment (ask what fenar and Cirren needs). I'd also like to look into a property we can buy in Orsaven for when we stay here.' Authorizes recovered equipment liquidation and ordinary provisioning; no specified expensive equipment or house purchase, show choices. Source-pinned D324 arrival, tracker inventory, companion character/features, market owners stock/dealers/events/rules, world/politics/human-states.md Orsaven lived districts, existing Margin & Seal estate appraisal, 5etools approved 2014 PHB base items blob 5b9bbb70f3478a83c21a0766c569345151a69a0c, 2014 MM original loot, items blob6307a1f3a604c4ef3b2a368c3add099494627864 HotDQ Insignia of Claws and magicvariants blob7a931eb3fc0fb1f0d415d566af1844e1c6529d04 DMG +1 shield. Before RNG full replacement349gp, base half174gp5sp, DC18=185, DC23=195, actual total18,185gp proceeds; actual no change overdue Bloodhound d10085/35, next349. Two ordinary purchases/sales actual, three additional days supply before D324 already paid, only current extra5 days for8gp5sp. Independent NPC preferences and newly authored modest seller-owned property and distinct consignment leads, not alleged existing repository offers or guaranteed titles. G1 Orsaven commercial/social context and real contacts, G2 player free to select/refuse, G3 ordinary resale and price arithmetic, verified mechanics and explicit offers, no forced checks for asking price, no major purchases without chosen terms. D324~17:50 Orsaven commercial district, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar and own coach/four horses healthy. V explicitly authorizes selling recovered arms and buying supplies, asks companions' needs, magic equipment and residential purchase options. Actual resale of entire eight-piece D321 haul, scimitar1 daggers2 longsword1 shortsword1 heavy crossbow1 studded leather1 splint1, all serviceable; original PHB replacement value349gp, baseline secondhand174gp5sp. Mara meaningful Help and Cirren Guidance, actual advantage5,7 +Persuasion6+Luckstone1+Guidance4=18, DC18 improved185gp bid, accepted under sale authorization, cash received once and all eight items transferred. Supplies +15 rations and20 feed at established5sp/5cp each, cost8gp5sp paid once, quantities6/8→21/28 (7 days). Purse3192gp3sp6cp→3368gp8sp6cp. No further payment or item purchase. Companions' needs: Fenar independent preference for fitted breastplate (400gp ordinary asking, AC14→16, no stealth disadvantage, no interference with Rage/Bestial Soul/greataxe; half plate750gp AC17 but stealth disadvantage, she prefers breastplate); Cirren has breastplate/shield, Boots of Elvenkind and reserved300gp Revivify diamond, favors +1 Shield to reach AC19 and protect concentration without attunement, does not need duplicate ordinary equipment. Two existing verified local magic sales: Forecaster's Cloak at Two Spindles36gp, Bloodhound Amulet at Copper Nose240gp. D321 overdue Bloodhound review genuine d10085 >35 no change, next349; D322 withdrawn Bands review no eligible supplier/reauthorization, deterministic no change next357. Do not reroll or offer withdrawn/sold items; post exact market events later. New actual D324 targeted equipment consignment inquiries, justified by distinct armorer/clasp-jeweler supply contacts and explicit request: +1 Shield, separate owner-authorized original consignment of a retired caravan guard captain at the arms dealer, 450gp, DMG2014 p200 and PHB shield p144 variant, AC+1 in addition to shield normal+2, no attune; Insignia of Claws, distinct owner-authorized original from retired beast hunter via a clasp jeweler,390gp, HotDQ p94 2014-compatible, +1 attacks and damage with natural weapons/unarmed strikes, magical, no attune, Fenar actual Beast claws and Longtooth natural fangs only, not mechanical greataxe rend; separate piece not consuming any UNASSIGNED-CITY package or copying physical stock. Both asking prices confirmed as available for purchase but no hold/transfer. Previously named Serpent Dart, Hadiya's Handy Quill and Weaving Wasp Needles exact inquiries remain open, no fabricated delivery or commission; can follow up at known named shops. Margin & Seal established appraisal contact introduces two newly available owner-authorized residential asking-price leads: 1450gp ordinary merchant's townhouse near Exchange/market, three bedrooms plus attic sleeping room, study, small courtyard, no private four-horse stabling, public livery nearby; seller household relocating to join relatives. 2250gp enclosed four-bedroom townhouse with study, kitchen, gated carriage courtyard, stable four horses, secure storage, in established Old Crown civic residential area, offered by retiring merchant moving to rural household. These are new in-play seller quotes not already owned property/canon historic estate prices; viewings feasible tomorrow, condition/deeds/title costs and staffing to be checked before any accepted purchase, no deposit or hold. No automatic house income, title, staff contract, overnight, or political privilege. User chooses which equipment, magic item, home inspection, and lodging. Party unchanged V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40. Rest3/6, no D324 night yet. No new quest or correspondence delivery; V retains sealed Crown letter/limited credentials, separate intelligence introduction, original Kestrel evidence, others custody unchanged; remaining Crown300+1300 and scholarly300/800 contingent; Elara Caereth, Severin reply unverified. Dice delegated until stop.
